title: StarCraft II
summary: A science-fiction real-time strategy trilogy in which three very different species (humans, an evolving swarm and a psionic race) mine resources, build bases and armies, and fight across campaigns, ladder matches and a two-player co-op mode. Its co-op mode, where each player picks a levelling commander with call-down powers, became its most-played way to play.

features.how: Worker units mine mineral patches and harvest gas from geysers; a later expansion shrank each patch and raised the starting workers so players must expand to new bases sooner.
Every unit costs supply and the cap is raised by building supply structures (depots for humans, psi for the psionic race, control for the swarm) up to a hard limit of 200.
Players place production, tech and defence buildings, then claim extra resource sites as expansions that must be defended.
Each species produces differently: humans train from buildings with add-ons, the swarm hatches units from larvae that queens can boost, and the psionic race warps units into any powered field.
Buildings and add-ons gate stronger units and research, such as a siege unit needing a robotics facility plus a robotics bay.

The terrain is shown greyed out, but enemy units and buildings are only seen where your units have vision, and old sightings stay frozen at their last known state until a scout or a scan sweep refreshes them.
Large armies are selected and ordered in real time, and many units carry active abilities (teleporting shades, steerable energy balls, transforming jets) that reward precise control.
The three species share no units and each has its own economy trick: humans drop extra miners and supplies, the swarm injects larvae, the psionic race speeds production with a time boost.
Two players each pick a commander and play campaign-style missions against an AI enemy, grouped as Assault (storm strongholds), Control (escort and map control) and Siege (hold points against waves).
Co-op commanders have a top bar of global powers on cooldowns or an energy pool, such as calling in a battlecruiser for 60 seconds, an airstrike, orbital lasers or a shield over every allied unit.
Some co-op commanders fight through a single strong hero who spawns for free a few minutes in and revives for free when killed, with the army built to support them.
Each commander levels to 15 unlocking new units and upgrades, then earns mastery points (up to 90) to tune bonuses, and prestige talents that trade a strong advantage for a drawback.
A weekly mutation stacks rule changes on a co-op mission (enemies gain a one-time shield, nukes fall at random, enemy buildings attack) for a bonus experience bounty.
Between campaign missions players explore a ship hub, spend mission money on units and upgrades unavailable in multiplayer, and choose between branching missions.
A built-in map and mod editor publishes to an online arcade, where players made shooters, tower defence and battle-arena maps.
Versus play uses a ladder with a separate matchmaking rating per race.

title: Warcraft III: Reforged
summary: A remaster of the 2002 fantasy RTS in which four factions (humans, orcs, undead and night elves) gather gold and lumber, build bases and lead armies under levelling hero units. It mixed RTS with RPG growth and, through its map editor, gave birth to the MOBA genre.

features.how: Workers mine gold from mines and chop lumber from trees, and each faction collects in its own way (undead haunt mines and send ghouls for wood, night elves entangle mines with wisps that eat trees).
Food from farms and similar buildings caps how many units you can field at once.
Above set army sizes your gold income is cut, pushing players to fight with small, well-used armies.
Up to three heroes per player gain experience from kills, reach level 10, learn one of four spells per level point (an ultimate at level 6), carry items and are revived at an altar.
Neutral creeps guard gold mines and shops; killing them gives heroes experience, gold and item drops, and most fall asleep at night.
A day/night clock shrinks sight at night, puts creeps to sleep for safer scouting, and lets some night-elf units turn invisible while standing still.
The map starts hidden; explored areas out of sight fall under fog where terrain shows but enemy movement and building do not.
Each faction builds differently: human peasants can help build together, undead buildings must sit on spreading blight, and night-elf ancients can uproot and walk.
Upgrading the main hall through three tiers unlocks further buildings, units and research.
Four factions with unique units, buildings, heroes and build methods.
Four faction campaigns told in chapters with in-mission main and hidden side quests, and heroes whose levels carry over between missions.
The World Editor let players build custom maps, including tower defence and the battle-arena map that became the MOBA genre.
Anonymous skill-based matchmaking for solo and arranged team games, with a ladder of standings.

title: Age of Empires IV
summary: A historical RTS set from the early Middle Ages to the early Renaissance, where villagers gather food, wood, gold and stone while the player advances through four ages by building landmarks. Its many civilizations play very differently, from nomads who pack up their buildings to a variant led by a single levelling hero.

features.how: Villagers gather four resources (food from sheep, deer, boar, berries and farms; wood; gold; stone) and drop them at nearby camps or mills.
Houses raise the population limit, though some civilizations skip houses entirely and start at the maximum.
Players advance through Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Ages by building one of two landmark buildings, each landmark giving its own bonus.
Each age unlocks buildings, units and technologies, with unique units and techs per civilization.
Grid-based building with wooden palisades, stone walls that only siege can hurt, keeps and towers; units can walk and fight on walls.
Some buildings project an influence area that boosts what is built inside it, such as farms near a mill gathering faster.
Twenty-plus civilizations, e.g. nomads who can pack up and move every building, dynasties unlocked by building both landmarks of an age, or free but slow research.

One variant civilization is led by a hero who starts as a worker, earns experience from gathering, building and fighting, and at each level picks a path (melee or ranged, then companion troops, then a cannon form).
Games can be won by destroying all landmarks, building and holding a Wonder, or capturing and holding all Sacred Sites with religious units.
Neutral Sacred Sites are captured by standing a monk on them for 30 seconds, giving a gold trickle and a countdown toward victory.
Line of sight is blocked by obstacles such as forests, and stealth forests let units hide.
Historical campaigns told in grouped missions with documentary narration, plus an Art of War series of tutorial challenges.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3
summary: A tongue-in-cheek alternate-history RTS where three powers (Allies, Soviets and a psychic-tech Empire) harvest ore, build bases on land and sea, and race to superweapons. Every campaign mission is played with a partner, human or AI.

features.how: Each faction's nine-mission campaign is fully co-operative with a second player online or an AI partner that takes simple orders, and the two share income.
Vulnerable collector vehicles harvest from fixed ore mines and bring it back to refineries.
Bases (and even whole bases on water) are built near the core structure, except the Empire, whose buildings have no proximity rule so it can grab ore faster.
A shallow but wide tree of structures leads to elite units and superweapons.
Each faction ends its tree in a base-levelling weapon: a teleporting Chronosphere and a Proton Collider, an Iron Curtain and a Vacuum Imploder, or a psionic wave and a nanoswarm dome.
Experience earned in battle buys commander powers such as air strikes, recon sweeps and satellite beams that cost no resources but have long cooldowns.
Almost every unit has one extra ability on the same key, such as a tank that switches to a life-draining beam or a walker that bull-rushes.
Many units are amphibious and every multiplayer map has water, so ignoring the sea gives away much of the economy.
Soviets favour cheap brute force, Allies nonlethal gadgets and air power, and the Empire transforming units that switch land, sea and air.
Players command combined land, sea and air forces with hard counters, so a rifleman can shrug off an anti-tank cannon.
Missions are bridged by live-action video briefings with a famous cast.

title: League of Legends
summary: A free-to-play 5v5 battle arena where each player controls one champion, levels up and buys items within a match, and the team pushes down three lanes to destroy the enemy Nexus. It is the template for the modern MOBA: lanes, turrets, minion waves, a jungle and team-wide objective monsters.

features.how: Three lanes (top, mid, bottom) guarded by turrets and inhibitors; minion waves march from each base, and breaking an inhibitor spawns stronger allied minions in that lane. An all-random mode puts both teams on one long lane with no jungle for quick brawls.
Champions start every match at level 1, earn experience and gold from minions, monsters and kills, and lose everything when the match ends.
Gold buys items from a shop that can only be used while standing in your own base.
The jungle between lanes holds monster camps that respawn; one player usually farms them and ambushes lanes.
Strong river monsters need several players: dragons give permanent team buffs, the Rift Herald becomes an allied siege unit, and Baron Nashor empowers the team's minions.
Fallen champions return at their base fountain after a timer.
Each champion has a passive, three basic abilities and a powerful ultimate on a long cooldown.
Players pick from a large roster of champions before the match, with classic positions per lane.
A ranked ladder with ten tiers from Iron to Challenger.
Enemies are only visible near your own units and structures, so the jungle hides ambushes.
A built-in auto-battler mode has players buy units from a shop and place them on a board to fight automatically.

title: Dota 2
summary: Valve's sequel to the Warcraft III mod that founded the MOBA: two teams of five heroes push three lanes to destroy the enemy Ancient. It is known for depth: a draft phase, last-hitting and denying, a day-night cycle, runes and a respawning boss.

features.how: Three lanes with towers on each side; creep waves spawn from barracks inside each base and march toward the enemy.
Heroes are drafted before the match and leave the pool once picked; a captains mode has one player per team pick for everyone.
Heroes start at level 1 with one ability, gain a level-up point to learn or improve abilities up to level 30, and unlock the ultimate at level 6.
A talent tree offers a choice of upgrades at set levels during the match.
Abilities cost mana that slowly regenerates and then go on cooldown.
Only the hero who lands the killing blow on a creep gets its gold, and players can deny by finishing their own creeps.
Gold from kills, structures and creeps buys items at shops on the map; items are open to every hero.
Neutral creeps live in jungle camps, attack only if provoked, and respawn over time.
Roshan, a respawning boss either team can kill, drops special items such as one that brings its holder back to life once.
Runes spawn at set spots every few minutes with temporary power-ups such as double damage or invisibility.
A day-night cycle changes vision and some hero abilities.
The map is always covered in fog except near your team's units.
An arcade of community-made modes, one of which launched the auto-chess genre.

title: Heroes of the Storm
summary: Blizzard's crossover MOBA in which 5v5 teams of heroes from its other games fight to destroy the enemy Core on many themed battlegrounds. It streamlines the genre with shared team experience, talents instead of item shops, and a map objective on every battleground.

features.how: Experience from minions, structures and camps goes to the whole team, so every hero on a team levels up together.
Every few levels each player picks one talent that adds or changes an ability, with big choices at level 10 (one of two heroics) and 20.
Each battleground has its own objective, such as collecting tributes to curse the enemy's minions or capturing two obelisks to turn a hero into a dragon knight.
Lanes of forts and keeps with minion waves lead to each team's Core.
Mercenary camps can be captured to fight for your team, alongside powerful battleground bosses.
Every hero can mount up for extra speed, dismounting when attacking or hit.
A channelled Hearthstone teleports a hero back to base, where the Hall of Storms restores health and repels enemies.
Draft modes alternate picks and up to three bans per team, while quick match lets players bring a preferred hero.
Storm League ranks players from Bronze to Grand Master with divisions and a top-100 leaderboard.
Training and versus-AI modes fill teams with computer heroes at chosen difficulties.
A rotating Brawl mode changes the rules every two weeks, from single-lane arenas to mini-games like dodgeball.

title: Pokémon Unite
summary: A family-friendly 5v5 MOBA with 10-minute matches where Pokémon defeat wild Pokémon for energy and dunk it into the other team's goal zones for points. Each player's Pokémon starts weak and evolves during the match, and a legendary boss near the end can swing the score.

features.how: Instead of destroying a base, players carry energy from defeated wild Pokémon into enemy goal zones; the team with more points after 10 minutes wins.
Many Pokémon evolve mid-match at set levels, gaining stats and new moves.
Pokémon level up from wild Pokémon, scoring and knockouts, choosing between two moves at certain levels.
Each Pokémon unlocks a Unite Move at a set level that charges over time.
Wild Pokémon spawn across the map and give experience and energy when defeated.
A legendary boss appears late in the match; the team that lands the final blow can score instantly in enemy goals for 30 seconds.
Lanes of goal zones on each side; destroying an active goal zone opens the next one behind it.
There is no live scoreboard, only announcements near the end saying whether your team is far ahead or behind, so losing teams do not quit early.
A Quick Battle mode runs 5-minute matches on smaller maps with three or four per team.
Ranked matches are played on the main map.

skills.does: Wraps itself and nearby allies in cotton that absorbs damage, then heals.

skills.name: Cotton Cloud Crash
skills.does: Its Unite Move: floats up invincible, then pounds down to shove enemies and heal allies.

makeItOurs: Sprout Score: two teams of critter-kids catch glow-bugs in the meadow and run them into the other team's flower baskets for points, their critter growing into a bigger form mid-match, with a thunder-owl in the last two minutes that makes baskets open wide.

title: Fortnite Battle Royale
summary: A free-to-play battle royale where up to 100 players skydive onto an island, loot weapons and race a shrinking storm, with a signature system for harvesting materials and building walls and ramps mid-fight. It is also a platform of seasons, live events and player-made islands.

features.how: The safe area is the eye of a storm that shrinks over the match, and players outside it take growing damage.
Each round starts with everyone skydiving from a flying bus and choosing where to land.
A pickaxe harvests wood, stone and metal from almost anything, which players spend to build walls, floors, ramps and roofs in seconds; lighter materials build faster but break easier.
Chests at named landmarks hold weapons in rarity tiers from Common to Mythic and Exotic, with only five inventory slots.
In squads a downed player can be revived, and eliminated players can be brought back at scarce reboot vans.
Solo, duos, trios or squads of four.
Bots fill matches for newer players, and hostile NPCs can be beaten for loot while friendly NPCs sell items, heal or join as allies.
A Creative mode and an editor let players build their own islands and modes for others to play.
A Zero Build mode removes building and adds a regenerating overshield instead.
A Reload mode uses smaller islands with automatic respawns until the final moments.
One-time live events in the world, such as a rocket launch or a concert, change the island for the next season.
Ranked and skill-based matchmaking for build and no-build play.

makeItOurs: Pillow Fort Royale: players parachute from a hot-air balloon onto a giant bedroom, gather blocks and cushions to snap up walls and ramps, and tag each other with foam blasters while a tide of sleepy-fog rolls in from the edges.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds
summary: The game that made battle royale a genre: up to 100 players parachute onto a large map with nothing, scavenge weapons, armour and vehicles, and fight to be the last alive inside a shrinking blue wall. It plays as a grounded military shooter with long, tense rounds.

features.how: Every few minutes the safe area shrinks toward a random spot, shown as a blue wall; players outside take rising damage.
Players jump from a plane whose flight path changes each round and decide when to parachute out.
Weapons, armour and gear are scattered at match start, with riskier areas holding better items, and defeated players can be looted.
Cars and other vehicles found on the map help players cross huge maps and outrun the zone.
A plane drops a care package with rare items at random or where a flare gun is fired, marked by red smoke that draws fights.
Random red zones are bombed during the match after a warning.
Solo, duo or squads of up to four.
Players can play in first or third person, and servers can force one view.
A rotating event mode changes the rules, such as larger squads or a different weapon spread.

makeItOurs: Paper Plane Drop: kids glide from a paper plane onto a huge model-railway countryside, hop in toy cars, chase supply kites that drop rare water balloons, and stay ahead of a rising tide of bath bubbles.

title: Apex Legends
summary: A free-to-play squad battle royale where trios each pick a different Legend with its own tactical, passive and ultimate ability. It added fluid movement, a smart ping system and a way to bring dead teammates back.

features.how: Before the drop each squad member picks a Legend, and no Legend can be taken twice in one squad.
Legends belong to five classes (Assault, Skirmisher, Recon, Controller, Support), each with a tactical, a passive and an ultimate ability.
A ring closes around a random point, damaging anyone outside.
One squad member is jumpmaster and picks when and where the trio skydives, though others can break away.
A one-button ping marks enemies, items, places and plans for the squad without voice chat.
Knocked-down players can be revived, and fully killed players can be brought back by carrying their banner to a respawn beacon before it expires.
Players climb low walls, slide down slopes and ride ziplines across the map.
Later seasons let each Legend pick upgrades to their abilities as their armour levels up during a match.
A round-based 3v3 mode had players buy weapons and ability charges between rounds.
About twenty squads of three, made of friends or matched players, fight to be the last squad standing.

skills.name: Into the Void
skills.does: Phases out for a few seconds to reposition while unable to be hurt.

skills.name: Dimensional Rift
skills.does: Places a pair of linked portals so the squad can travel a long way safely.

skills.name: Eye of the Allfather
skills.does: A scan that reveals hidden enemies and traps ahead.

skills.name: Beast of the Hunt
skills.does: Gains speed and highlights enemies for a while.

skills.name: D.O.C. Heal Drone
skills.does: A drone heals nearby allies over time while they are not taking damage.

skills.name: Combat Revive
skills.does: Her drone revives knocked teammates automatically.

skills.name: D.O.C HALO
skills.does: Creates a large ring shield that blocks incoming fire.

skills.name: Dome of Protection
skills.does: Throws down a half-dome shield that blocks bullets.

skills.name: Gun Shield
skills.does: A shield forms around him while aiming.

skills.name: Defensive Bombardment
skills.does: Calls a damaging, stunning cluster strike onto a target area.

skills.name: Grappling Hook
skills.does: Grapples to reach high places and reposition.

skills.name: Zipline Gun
skills.does: Fires a zipline the whole squad can ride.

skills.name: Nox Gas Trap
skills.does: Places canisters that release toxic gas when enemies come near or shoot them.

skills.name: Nox Gas Grenade
skills.does: Throws a grenade that fills a large area with toxic gas.

makeItOurs: Glider Guild: trios of gadget-kids (a portal-maker, a bubble-shield builder, a medic with a hover-bot) drop into a canyon on gliders, ping finds to each other, ride rope-lines and carry a fallen friend's badge to a beacon to bring them back.

title: Overwatch 2
summary: A free-to-play first-person hero shooter where two teams of five (one tank, two damage, two support) fight over objectives such as capture points and moving payloads. Every hero has a distinct kit of abilities and a charged ultimate; the game was renamed simply Overwatch in 2026.

features.how: Heroes fall into tank, damage and support roles, and role queue builds teams of one tank, two damage and two supports.
Each hero has active abilities, a passive and an ultimate that charges up during play.
Control, Flashpoint and Clash modes have teams fight to capture and hold points, unlocking new points in turn.
Escort and Push modes have a team move a payload or robot forward by standing next to it while no enemy is close.
Players level up twice in a match and choose one of two perks each time that change an ability.
A best-of-seven Stadium mode gives cash after each round to buy upgrades for your hero.
A ping system points teammates at places and enemies.
Competitive matches let each team vote to ban two heroes for both sides.
Competitive ranks adjust after every match with a breakdown of what moved them.
Players can switch heroes when they respawn to answer the enemy's team.

skills.name: Barrier Field
skills.does: Holds up a large frontal energy barrier.

skills.name: Charge
skills.does: Charges forward and pins an enemy against a wall.

skills.name: Fire Strike
skills.does: Launches a fiery projectile.

skills.name: Earthshatter
skills.does: Knocks down all enemies in front of him.

skills.name: Blink
skills.does: Teleports a short way in the direction she is moving.

skills.name: Recall
skills.does: Travels back in time to her earlier position and health.

skills.name: Pulse Bomb
skills.does: Throws a powerful sticky explosive.

skills.name: Caduceus Staff
skills.does: A beam that heals an ally or boosts their damage.

skills.name: Guardian Angel
skills.does: Flies to an ally.

skills.name: Resurrect
skills.does: Revives a dead teammate.

skills.name: Valkyrie
skills.does: Gains flight and enhanced abilities.

skills.name: Cryo-Freeze
skills.does: Encases herself in ice, invulnerable while healing.

skills.name: Ice Wall
skills.does: Raises a wall of ice in front of her.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.does: Launches a weather drone that freezes enemies in a wide area.

skills.name: Deploy Turret
skills.does: Throws down a self-building turret.

skills.name: Overload
skills.does: Gains extra health and faster attack, movement and reload.

skills.name: Molten Core
skills.does: Creates pools of molten slag that damage enemies.

skills.name: Crossfade
skills.does: Switches between a song that heals nearby allies and one that speeds them up.

skills.name: Amp It Up
skills.does: Boosts the current song's effect.

skills.name: Soundwave
skills.does: A short-range blast that knocks enemies away.

skills.name: Sound Barrier
skills.does: Gives nearby allies temporary extra health.

makeItOurs: Parade Push: two teams of five (one shield-carrier, two blasters, two helpers) take turns pushing a float down a carnival street while the other side tries to hold it back, each hero charging a big signature move.

title: Clash Royale
summary: A mobile duel of three-minute battles where each player spends regenerating elixir to drop troops, buildings and spells from an eight-card deck across two lanes. Destroy more of the other side's towers, or their king tower, to win.

features.how: Players build an eight-card deck between battles, with four cards in hand at a time cycling as they are played.
Cards cost elixir that refills over time up to 10, doubling in the last minute and tripling in overtime.
A river with two bridges splits the arena into two lanes, each guarded by a princess tower with the king tower behind.
Troops and buildings can only be placed on your own half, but the zone grows into the enemy's half after you destroy a tower.
One-on-one ladder battles move players through themed arenas by trophies.
A 2v2 mode teams up friends or random players.
Duplicate cards and gold upgrade a card's level, and evolutions give certain cards a special ability.
Clans donate cards to each other and fight clan wars with four separate decks.
Draft challenges have players pick between pairs of cards to build a deck on the spot.
A Merge Tactics mode has four players merge units and send them into automatic battles.

skills.name: Dashing Dash
skills.does: Dashes toward enemies, chain-hitting everything in his path.

skills.name: Cloaking Cape
skills.does: Turns invisible and shoots faster for a short time.

skills.name: Soul Summoning
skills.does: Collects the souls of fallen troops and raises them as skeletons.

skills.name: Explosive Escape
skills.does: Burrows to the opposite lane, leaving a bomb behind.

makeItOurs: Sandcastle Siege: each player holds eight shell-cards and spends rising tide-points to drop crabs, kites and splash spells over two bridges, aiming to topple the other side's sandcastle towers before the tide comes in.

title: Brawl Stars
summary: A top-down mobile shooter of short 3v3 matches and a 10-player battle royale, where each Brawler has one attack and a Super charged by landing hits. Many quick modes (gem grab, soccer, heists, king of the hill) share one roster of over 100 Brawlers.

features.how: Brawlers belong to seven classes (damage dealer, marksman, tank, assassin, support, controller, artillery).
Each Brawler has a basic attack and a Super that charges by hitting enemies.
Showdown pits 10 players (solo, duo or trio) against each other while poison clouds close in.
In Showdown, power cubes from boxes and defeated rivals permanently raise health and damage for that match.
Brawl Ball has teams shoot a ball into the other goal, and Gem Grab has them hold ten gems for 15 seconds.
Hot Zone has teams stand in zones for a combined total time.
Many short modes rotate (heist, bounty, knockout, duels, a lane-and-turret arena), each with its own maps.
A map maker lets players build maps; player votes pick a daily featured map.
Coins and power points level up Brawlers, and gadgets, star powers, gears and hypercharges add abilities.
Ranked play climbs from Bronze to Pro with random 3v3 modes.
Clubs team up for a monthly event where each win adds to the club's reward.

skills.name: Buckshot
skills.does: A wide spread of pellets that hurts more up close.

skills.name: Super Shell
skills.does: A huge blast that breaks cover and knocks survivors back.

skills.name: Six-Shooters
skills.does: Fires a long, straight volley of six bullets.

skills.name: Bullet Storm
skills.does: Fires twelve piercing bullets that go extra far and break cover.

skills.name: Fists of Fury
skills.does: A quick flurry of four close-range punches.

skills.name: Flying Elbow Drop
skills.does: Leaps high and lands to damage and knock back enemies, breaking cover.

skills.name: Power Chord
skills.does: A wide sound wave that damages enemies and heals allies.

skills.name: Encore
skills.does: A bigger wave that heals him and every teammate it reaches.

skills.name: Shock Rifle
skills.does: An energy orb that bounces between up to three enemies.

skills.name: Scrappy!
skills.does: Throws down a gun turret that shoots enemies on its own.

skills.name: Needle Grenade
skills.does: A cactus that bursts into spikes in every direction.

skills.name: Stick Around!
skills.does: Lobs a grenade that leaves a patch of spikes that damages and slows.

makeItOurs: Pocket Party Brawl: ten pocket-sized heroes with one trick and one charged super each race to grab glow-cubes in a shrinking sandbox, with quick team side modes like dodge-ball goals and jelly-bean grab.
